name: gitmoji-cli
description_en: A gitmoji interactive cli tool for using emojis on commits. 💻
readme_excerpt: gitmoji-cli > A gitmoji interactive client for using gitmojis on commit messages. About This project provides an easy solution for using gitmoji from your command line. Gitmoji-cli solves the hassle of searching through the gitmoji list. Includes a bunch of options you can play with! :tada: Install npm brew Usage Commit You can use the commit functionality in two ways, directly or via a commit-hook.
